title: Worker scope check ignores ignored .krn agent state
body: Outcome: `krn worker` scope check ignores git-ignored agent state under `.krn/` (node compile cache in `.krn/tmp/node-compile-cache`, lead files in `.krn/runs`). Evidence: t-2t4fmn2 rounds 1-2 reported 'scope violation' listing only `.krn/tmp/node-compile-cache/*` and `.krn/runs/local-read/round2.md` while all tracked changes were inside --allow (.krn/runs/lead/local-read/round1.txt, round2.txt). Proof: an observer where a worker turn writes only ignored `.krn/` files plus allowed paths exits 0 without a violation; a tracked out-of-scope file still exits 3.
